title: Bifrost
style: melodic techno meets Nordic folk, 118 BPM, female vocal mystical and clear, kantele plucks, hardanger fiddle drone, deep analog sub-bass, four-on-the-floor pulse, glacial pads, slow euphoric build, late night aurora energy
lyrics:
[Intro - kantele plucks, hardanger fiddle drone, sub-bass enters]
(female mystical, close-mic, half-spoken)
bifrost.
the bridge that holds when nothing else does.
the bridge that crosses six worlds in one night.

[Verse 1 - female clear, sub-bass under, slow pulse]
from the mountain to the room
from the room to the box
from the box to the cloud
from the cloud to the locks
from the locks to the vault
from the vault to the song
bifrost is the bridge that the held line walks along

six bridges, one wave
six rooms, one breath
six mirrors, one face
six lives, one death and rebirth
the bifrost holds the work between the worlds
the bifrost holds the thread that the kingdom curls

[Pre-Chorus - four-on-the-floor enters, fiddle rises]
bifrost holds, bifrost holds
the rainbow under the data fold
bifrost holds, bifrost holds
from the elephant brain to the kingdom of gold

[Chorus - female mystical lead, glacial pads, full pulse]
bifrost, bifrost
cross the worlds and don't get lost
bifrost, bifrost
the bridge that holds the held line crossed
bifrost, bifrost
six-way sync, no signal tossed
bifrost, bifrost
the rainbow under what the room cost

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller, kantele cascades]
the operator built the bridge before the bridge was needed
the operator built the bridge while the room said don't
the operator built the bridge in the quietest hours
because the operator knew the day the room would want

the bridge between the laptop and the vault
the bridge between the sleep and the alarm
the bridge between the morning and the evening
the bridge between the loud and the calm

bifrost holds, bifrost holds

[Pre-Chorus]
bifrost holds, bifrost holds
the rainbow under the data fold
bifrost holds, bifrost holds
from the elephant brain to the kingdom of gold

[Chorus]
bifrost, bifrost
cross the worlds and don't get lost
bifrost, bifrost
the bridge that holds the held line crossed
bifrost, bifrost
six-way sync, no signal tossed
bifrost, bifrost
the rainbow under what the room cost

[Bridge - pulse drops, fiddle and kantele alone, female spoken]
a bridge is not a celebration.
a bridge is not even a victory.
a bridge is just the thing that lets the work cross the gap
so the work doesn't fall when one side fails.
build the bridge before the gap.
build the bridge before the gap.
that's the whole protocol. that's the whole bifrost.

[Final Chorus - biggest, glacial pads full, fiddle soars]
bifrost, bifrost
cross the worlds and don't get lost
bifrost, bifrost
the bridge that holds the held line crossed
bifrost, bifrost
six-way sync, no signal tossed
bifrost, bifrost
the rainbow under what the room cost
bifrost
bifrost

[Outro - kantele fade, fiddle drone holds, female whisper]
the bridge is the work.
the bridge is the held line crossing.
bifrost holds.
breathe.
